title: Ordinary Hom complexes commute with scheme open restriction
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open subscheme, and L,M arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_Y-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. Write res_U for Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι, applied degreewise. There is an isomorphism of cochain complexes res_U(Hom^bullet_Y(L,M)) ≅ Hom^bullet_U(res_U L,res_U M), with Hom^bullet the ordinary sheaf Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex]. No boundedness, freeness, K-injectivity or derived-category hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08DL, Lemma 20.42.3, ordinary restriction in its construction; Section 21.34 (Tag 0A8X), product terms and differential; Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean, overEquiv and overFunctorEquiv

proof.text: Restrict the ordinary Hom complex to the localized over-U site using homComplex_restrict_open, which applies to arbitrary unbounded complexes.

Transport by Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U. On every open of U, the equivalence transports a local linear map to the identical local map on its image in Y, conjugated by the structure-sheaf appIso. This is an isomorphism of internal Hom sheaves: its inverse transports the same maps back; restrictions agree since appIso is natural. Precomposition and postcomposition agree by cancellation of the component isomorphisms.

The equivalence preserves the integer-indexed products defining each Hom degree. Apply the preceding factor isomorphisms to product projections. For the differential, postcomposition with d_M and precomposition with d_L agree with transport by the previous step. Additivity preserves their signed difference. Hence the product isomorphisms define a chain isomorphism by HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents.
Use Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U on L, M and their Hom complex to replace restriction followed by overEquiv by Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι, obtaining the displayed chain isomorphism.

from.place: Local Koszul derived sheaf Hom computation: transport the ordinary Hom complex from the over-open site to the open subscheme

lean.statement:
theorem homComplex_restrict_scheme {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens)
    (L M : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (homComplex (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf) L M) ≅
      homComplex (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M))
